items.text: This requires Supreme Court justices to exercise judicial restraint while making decisions on issues we as Americans hold most dear: life, liberty and property.
Thank you, Jack and Mary, for your kind words. Access to treatment for South Dakotans living with Alzheimer’s is crucial. Hoping to see CMS reconsider this policy soon.

Bob Sutton is a true leader who has spent his career focused on the well-being of South Dakotans, including his 10 years with Avera Health. Praying for him, Lori and their family as they navigate the coming months. https://t.co/A1SovUHyNd

Bright Star 23, a joint training exercise between the U.S. and Egyptian militaries, just wrapped up at the end of last week. Grateful for our strategic partnership with Egypt, which is highlighted by Bright Star.

Met with representatives from the South Dakota Emergency Nurses Association to talk about their work caring for patients in their most vulnerable moments. Appreciate everything they do to care for South Dakotans. https://t.co/HMg0roQs5Y

NEW: @SenBlumenthal and I introduced the Bolstering Research and Innovation Now (BRAIN) Act, bipartisan legislation to strengthen research and treatment development for brain tumors and to improve the accessibility of brain tumor health care.

More: https://t.co/ZYChxsMBSd

NEW: @SenCortezMasto and I introduced legislation to extend the emergency reporting deadline for tribal members who receive emergency care outside of IHS facilities. Patients would now have 15 days to report instead of 72 hours. 

More: https://t.co/D66BQWImAx

Dr. Mark Harlow is the Chief Medical Officer for the Oyate Health Center in Rapid City. Good to meet with him today to discuss issues facing tribal patients including access to purchase and referred care through Indian Health Service. https://t.co/fBjVKZnvwn

I had a fascinating meeting with RFK Jr. today ahead of his committee hearings. We had an excellent discussion on the need to incorporate AI in our health care. We agree that improving quality of life is critical and that AI can help in the development of vaccines as well as curing chronic illnesses in the near future. We also had a very frank discussion about South Dakota farmers and ranchers being concerned on any actions impacting their ability to feed and fuel the world that the Secretary of HHS might have a role in.

2/3rds of Medicare beneficiaries are living with two or more chronic illnesses, accounting for over 90% of Medicare spending. 

With AI advancements in health care, we can work toward a cure for many of these diseases – improving the quality of life for Americans and saving taxpayer dollars at the same time. 

Grateful President Trump agrees that AI can have a positive outcome on our country, and that we need to prioritize its development now.

Good meeting with representatives from the Community Health Associations of the Dakotas in DC. We had a great discussion about their work providing critical primary care services to South Dakotans. https://t.co/OgIPyjHb9c

I voted to confirm @RobertKennedyJr as the next Secretary of Health and Human Services. I supported his nomination, and I look forward to working with him as we accelerate the use of AI in developing cures for diseases such as cancer, Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s. https://t.co/rTXD1oeABh

Appreciated meeting with leaders from the Cheyenne River Sioux, Oglala Sioux and Rosebud Sioux tribes who made the trip to DC for a session with the National Congress of American Indians. We discussed important topics including improving public safety and tribal health care. https://t.co/3fzwb15X3z
Discussed Medicare physician fee cuts with these physicians from South Dakota. Thankful for the vital work they do for the health and well-being of our communities. https://t.co/gV9ERBbviv

NEW: I reintroduced the Purchased and Referred Care Improvement Act, legislation to require the Indian Health Service to reimburse tribal members for care sought outside of IHS in a timely manner.

More: https://t.co/xYPxbDD8l8

Great meeting with this crew of South Dakota small business owners. We talked about the importance of protecting the current tax treatment of small businesses, including LLCs, S-Corps and others, that was signed into law under the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act - something I fully support as a co-sponsor of the Main Street Tax Certainty Act. This will be a priority as we work on tax legislation this year.

NEW: I reintroduced legislation to extend the reporting deadline for Indian Health Service (IHS) patients who seek emergency care outside of IHS facilities.

More: https://t.co/DytxNoF7Uv

NEW: I reintroduced the Home-Based Telemental Health Care Act of 2025, legislation to expand mental health resources and substance use services in rural areas. 

More: https://t.co/R2h3oMWHd1

Nice to visit with Avera President and CEO Jim Dover and Vice President for Public Policy Kim Malsam-Rysdon. We discussed the critical role of air ambulance services and Medicaid in South Dakota and how we can work together to support patients across our state. https://t.co/6ieITQmkVz

NEW: I introduced legislation to help rural hospitals that are at risk of being closed. The Rural Hospital Technical Assistance Program Act would codify an existing pilot program administered by the U.S. Department of Agriculture that provides technical assistance to rural hospitals to prevent closures, improve their financial and operational performance and strengthen essential healthcare services in rural communities.

More: https://t.co/xSokTCDOmU

Great to see Jessica Larsen-Gallup, Director of Pharmacy Business and Analytics at Avera McKennan Hospital. We chatted about the importance of the 340B program and its impact on health care access for rural patients across our state. https://t.co/vI769138i5

Nice to meet with leaders of Monument Health, which employs over 5,000 people across West River. We had a great discussion at their HQ in Rapid City about their operations and the power of AI in healthcare. @_monumenthealth https://t.co/UdobqijHvy

Having gotten my start in the insurance industry, I always enjoy connecting with our South Dakota insurance agents. We discussed the importance of preserving our state based regulatory system and making permanent the critical tax relief for small businesses from the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act.

Busy week out here in Washington! It was nice to visit with South Dakotans from the South Dakota Association of Healthcare Organizations, the South Dakota Concerned Women for America, the Northern Great Plains Joint Venture, Thrivent, the American Kidney Fund and the Truck Trailer Manufacturers Association.

NEW: I've introduced the Bolstering Research and Innovation Now (BRAIN) Act, legislation to advance research for brain tumors and improve brain tumor treatment and care. 

More: https://t.co/5ElqP5xbTu
